verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships some built-in event-driven automation. Monitors automatically check connected systems and alert on compliance violations, integrations auto-satisfy evidence requests, access reviews send reminders on policy timelines, and admins can toggle on a stricter policy-approval workflow. None of the evidence shows users authoring their own trigger→action rules; these are vendor-defined behaviors with on/off configuration. Missing for 10: a user-configurable rules/workflow builder, custom event triggers, custom actions (e.g. webhooks, task creation), and independent corroboration.
